dayNotePrefix: Walk or bike the closed 6.5 miles of Olympic Hot Springs Road from the Madison Falls gate to the Whiskey Bend trailhead first.
why: Sources 2026-10-29: NPS Elwha River Trail page nps.gov/olym/planyourvisit/elwha-river-trail.htm (no vehicle access past Madison Falls, road adds 7 mi to Whiskey Bend, 28.4 mi Whiskey Bend to Low Divide, no reopen date); NPS alert listing updated 2026-10-08 (closed at Madison Falls, 6.5 mi to Whiskey Bend, ~8 to Boulder Creek); WTA whiskey-bend-to-low-divide (6.2 mi one-way); NPS trail conditions page June 2026 (hike the road from the Madison Falls gate). Sources disagree 6.2/6.5/7; used 6.5 (middle, matches the current alert). Road gain not sourced, so none added. Itinerary day1+2 = 16.8 mi to Hayes River matches the ~16 mi Whiskey Bend to Hayes figure in the row's own approach text, so stored miles start at Whiskey Bend despite the day-1 note naming Madison Falls; road added to first and last days.
